svg.title: Route 59: gatehouse to warehouse
svg.desc: Schematic native tile map with the actual tested approach. Start at the southern gatehouse and travel northwest to the warehouse, using Surf across water. North is up. This is not game artwork.

g.text: North is up · schematic · Surf used on the tested route
Pink line: observed walking / Surf approach. Gray: blocked tiles.
Blue: water. Pale green: other passable tiles. Doors and events still apply.
From Mandarin City, leave the northern gatehouse onto Route 59.
At the warehouse, face the door and press A to use the Old Key.
